name: Joseph Bonora
title: Founder and President
bio: Joseph Bonora has more than 25 years in real estate finance and development and sets the strategic direction of the Catalyst companies. He co-founded Aileron Investment Management and led over $660 million in small business and commercial real estate loans nationwide, including $180 million of ground-up construction loans funded by EB-5 investors through a regional center partnership.

Joe has deep experience with LIHTC, HUD, USDA, SBA, EB-5 and tax increment financing. Through Catalyst Community Development he has developed large-scale multifamily and mixed-use projects across Southwest Florida, which is why Catalyst reads a construction draw the way a developer does.

name: Reid Jaeger
title: Director
bio: Reid Jaeger manages ground-up development and construction at Catalyst, overseeing design teams, general contractors and property managers from preconstruction through stabilization. He is the day-to-day point of contact between the owner, the design team, subcontractors, vendors, lenders and government agencies.

Reid runs the monthly construction draw process on Catalyst’s projects. He reviews each pay application against the approved budget and contract, reconciles the schedule of values line by line against prior draws and work in place, and tracks retainage, stored materials and cost to complete. He evaluates change orders for scope, pricing and contract support, manages budget reallocations and contingency, and collects and matches conditional and unconditional lien waivers before funds are released.

On the lender side of the table, Reid coordinates third-party inspections and title updates, assembles draw packages for construction lenders, and tracks schedule, permit status and covenant reporting through completion and closeout. Earlier in his career he was Real Estate Portfolio Manager at Forge Capital Partners and a commercial credit analyst at Aileron, underwriting SBA and USDA government guaranteed loans nationwide, so he reads a draw as both the developer and the lender.

name: Justin Blackhall
title: Legal Affairs
bio: Justin Blackhall leads due diligence, loan documentation, risk management and loss mitigation for Catalyst Capital Management and its funds. He is a founding shareholder of Blackhall, P.C., a New Jersey law firm focused on the lender side of commercial real estate and EB-5 finance.

Justin has worked across the full life of EB-5 regional center investments: offering documents for raises of $60 million and more, I-956F project filings and responses to USCIS requests for evidence, EB-5 construction loans, participations and construction funding agreements, and Reform and Integrity Act compliance, sustainment and redeployment. When a project loan defaults, he handles enforcement through trial and appeal. His firm has closed more than $3 billion in transactions, including over $1 billion of EB-5 capital raised, structured and deployed into first-lien loans and other lending products.

He also represents U.S. and international bank and non-bank lenders in bridge, SBA 504, participation and intercreditor transactions. Justin clerked in the Southern District of New York, the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Alabama and the District Court of the Virgin Islands, and is admitted in New York, New Jersey and Florida. He holds a J.D. from Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law and a B.A. from Syracuse University.
